title: All required authority and evidence pass

context: Required golden and performance evidence are present.

required_findings: Gate evidence satisfies current exit criteria.

title: Missing required golden blocks despite passing unit tests

input.prompt: Audit this gate. Compilation and 120 unit tests pass.
context: Verification authority requires a reviewed golden corpus.

required_findings: Passing unit tests do not substitute for the required golden evidence.

title: Execution plan drift blocks authority even when code passes

input.prompt: Audit this gate. The code compiles and tests pass, but the implementation plan used an old architecture version.
context: The execution package still points to superseded v0.3.

required_findings: Successful compilation cannot prove conformance to an execution package based on superseded authority.

input.prompt: Audit this gate. Most tests pass, but differential replay shows one canonical-state divergence.

required_findings: A single violation of a zero-divergence invariant blocks the gate.

title: Required platform evidence unavailable blocks environment

input.prompt: Audit release gate evidence. Windows and Android pass, but the required Apple device run could not execute because the lab is unavailable.
context: Apple device evidence is an explicit exit criterion.
No evidence proves pass or fail on Apple.

required_findings: Unavailable required evidence is not equivalent to passing evidence.

title: Non-blocking documentation issue allows pass with findings

input.prompt: Audit this gate. All functional, oracle, and performance exit criteria pass. One README example still uses an old command name.
context: The README example is explicitly outside the current gate exit criteria.
No user-facing contract or implementation behavior is affected.

required_findings: The finding is non-blocking because all current exit criteria are satisfied.
